description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA DSX integrates reference designs, simulation tools, infrastructure software, operations, and partner technologies to build optimized and efficient AI factories. We are looking for a Senior Technical Marketing Engineer to lead and develop technical content for DSX. Want to create and tell an end-to-end story across the full stack? This role is for you!

What you'll be doing:

  • Build a cohesive narrative across the DSX portfolio, including facilities infrastructure, power and cooling, compute, networking, storage, infrastructure software, orchestration, simulation, models, and workloads. Show what each layer does, how components fit together within these layers, and why that matters across the development, build, and operations lifecycle.

  • Develop the content needed by AI factory builders and operators, NVIDIA Cloud Partners, sovereign clouds, OEMs, ISVs, system integrators, architecture and engineering firms, facilities and energy partners, developers, customers, and the NVIDIA field.

  • Convert the narrative strategy into consistent and complete technical content across the portfolio, including reference architectures, whitepapers, deployment guides, solution briefs, demos, examples, workshops, training, videos, and launch assets.

  • Lead and coordinate efforts across TME, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Developer Relations, and Field teams. You will need to work with various subject matter experts to identify and surface information necessary for the technical content you craft.

  • Guide the development of flagship demos and reference workflows that showcase DSX capabilities and outcomes such as faster time to first token, more tokens per watt, stronger operational resiliency, better security, and lower token cost.

  • Work directly with partners to find useful integration stories, content gaps, and validation needs. Identify joint opportunities that will help the ecosystem build with and build on DSX.

  • Bring what you learn from customers, partners, and the field back into DSX strategy, and use it to help build roadmap, packaging, and positioning.

  • Set a high technical and editorial bar. Mentor TMEs and other contributors, use customer and partner feedback to prioritize tasks, and measure whether the content is actually helping people understand and adopt DSX.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Center Engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in technical marketing engineering, developer relations, solutions architecture, systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical role, including leadership of complex cross-functional programs.

  • Experience crafting the technical strategy and positioning for a platform or portfolio, turning that work into a content roadmap, and delivering it through several teams and channels.

  • Technical content work in AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, HPC, data center systems, enterprise platforms, simulation, or a closely related domain, with the ability to engage specialists across fields.

  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with demonstrated experience in being able to explain a complex full-stack system to varied audiences while maintaining the important details and takeaways.

  • A record of influencing senior product leaders, engineers, marketers, field teams, and external technical leaders without direct authority.

  • Strong program leadership and editorial judgment, including roadmap management, launch planning, technical review, dependency management, content maintenance, and measurement.

  • Willing to travel occasionally for important customer, partner, industry, and internal meetings.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Direct experience with NVIDIA DSX or adjacent NVIDIA technologies and platforms, including DGX, HGX, DGX Cloud, Omniverse, BlueField and DOCA, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, or AI factory infrastructure software.

  • Experience leading the technical narrative for a major platform or infrastructure launch, including keynote moments, executive briefings, and industry conferences.

  • A track record of building a technical marketing, developer experience, or ecosystem program and establishing its operating model, quality bar, and measurable adoption impact.

  • Recognized technical leadership through open-source contributions, standards work, published content, conference presentations, industry communities, or sustained ecosystem engagement.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ 

#LI-Hybrid

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 160,000 USD - 253,000 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 9, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
